A legendary hero of the [[S'kytri]] people, '''Hormaket the Vanquisher''' was the leader of the S'kytri in their war against the ground dwellers who threatened the equilibrium of the world.

==The legend==
On the primordial world of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]], the planet's surface was covered in cataclysmic events encouraged by [[mutant]] [[blorgworm]]s, five-headed [[gogitol]]s, blood-sucking beasts. The firmament above remained free of these monstrosities and from the interactions of the [[Great Wind]] with the towering [[Canaitith Mountain]], the S'kytri were created. Descending down upon the world, the S'kytri, under the leadership of Hormaket the Vanquisher, dispatched the ground-dwelling evils and imprisoned them for eternity in the [[Entyrmion]].
